thread:
Dana M.: Hey team — kickoff for the EdgeWorks field benchmark sprint. Goal: joint perf/W + tail-latency sweep for our 8-bit quantized Llama-variant on their A1 board. Two-week sprint, incremental checkpoints.

Matt R.: 👍 timeline looks good. Do we have the target workloads?

Dana M.: Primary: chat-gen (seq len 512, batch 1), throughput (seq len 128, batch 8), and embedding extraction (batch 64). Power measured at PSU sense. Need perf/W and 95th pct latency.

Jia L.: Added run configs to the shared drive. Key flags: --kv-cache=on, --quant=8bit, kernel=custom-v2. Also include a cold-start sample to measure init latency.

Alex (EdgeWorks): Confirmed. We'll run on three firmware revisions: stock, kernel-v2, kernel-v2+memopt. We'll ship airflow telemetry and per-socket wattage logs. Any specific metrics format?

Olivia S.: Prefer CSV with headers: workload, model, seq_len, batch, avg_tokens_s, p95_latency_ms, power_W, perf_per_W. Include run metadata: git commit, kernel tag, board serial.

Jia L.: Perfect. Add these env snippets to the run script:
```bash
export RW_MODEL=llama-8b-quant
export RW_SEQ=512
export RW_BATCH=1
./run_inference --model $RW_MODEL --seq $RW_SEQ --batch $RW_BATCH --profile > out.json
```

Matt R.: For kernel tuning, list the top 3 knobs we want a sweep on. I suggest: prefetch-lines, warp_tile_size, and l2_cache_partition. Keep each to 3 values to limit runs.

Alex (EdgeWorks): Got it. We'll schedule param sweep across the three firmware images. Expect ~72 jobs. BenchBot: please queue.

BenchBot: Benchmark jobs queued: jobgroup-4721 (72 jobs). ETA for full sweep on single rack: ~18 hours.

Dana M.: Great — can we get preliminary perf/W numbers after the first 6 hours? Need them to decide whether to push memopt into the next firmware patch.

Alex (EdgeWorks): Yes — we'll post interim CSV + highlights to this thread.

Olivia S.: Also flagging the marketing timeline: partner blog + joint bench report target 3/31. That assumes we get clean perf improvements and signoff on numbers.

Jia L.: One more ask: include raw traces (kv cache hits, token timing) for a few representative runs. We'll use them for root-cause on regressions. Small logs only (10MB each).

Alex (EdgeWorks): Will include. Anything else?

Matt R.: Ensure telemetry includes CPU steal and IRQ rates — sometimes OS jitter skews p95.

Dana M.: Nice call. Ok team — first checkpoint at +6h (1905127056). Please post CSV and a 1-line summary. :rocket:

BenchBot: Checkpoint reminder set for 6 hours.

Alex (EdgeWorks): Copy. Posting first results to the shared drive and pinging here when ready.

Dana M.: Thanks — excited to see the numbers.
